map.提示：峰值VO₂<12(或<50%预测值)是心脏移植的传统指征，β受体阻滞剂时代: Note: peak VO2<12 (or <50% predicted) is the traditional heart-transplant indication; beta-blocker era relaxed to <10. VE/VCO2 slope >36 is an independent prognostic factor. RER>=1.10 suggests maximal effort, reliable data. CPET is the gold standard for unexplained dyspnea. For clinical reference only.
map.VO₂peak 与峰值摄氧：运动至极限的摄氧峰值，反映有氧能力，心衰/肺病患者降: VO2peak and peak oxygen uptake: the maximal oxygen uptake at exercise limit reflects aerobic capacity, reduced in heart failure/lung disease, a key prognostic and transplant metric.
map.无氧阈（AT）判定：摄氧随负荷线性上升出现拐点（VCO₂/VE 变化、RER≈1: Anaerobic threshold (AT): the inflection where oxygen uptake rises linearly with load (VCO2/VE change, RER~1.0), representing the ceiling of sustainable aerobic exercise, used to set target intensity.
map.VE/VCO₂ 斜率与 Weber 分级：通气效率斜率 >34–36 提示预后差: VE/VCO2 slope and Weber grading: ventilation-efficiency slope >34-36 suggests poor prognosis; with VO2peak classify heart failure A-D to guide treatment intensity.
map.输入：VO₂peak 14 ml/kg/min、AT 10、VE/VCO₂ 斜率: Input: VO2peak 14 ml/kg/min, AT 10, VE/VCO2 slope 38, peak power 100 W. Output: Weber grade C (VO2peak 10-16), ventilation efficiency poor (>36), note moderate-severe aerobic limitation, advice supervised low-moderate aerobic rehab and follow-up. Note: must be done by professionals in an exercise physiology lab.
map.在递增负荷运动中，当 CO₂ 排出增速超过摄氧增速、RER 接近 1.0 时出现: During incremental exercise, the inflection where CO2 output rise exceeds O2 uptake rise and RER nears 1.0 is AT, reflecting the ceiling of lactate-independent sustainable exercise; often used to set training intensity, safer than peak.
map.客观量化运动耐量，鉴别气促源于心/肺/体能；VO₂peak 与 VE/VCO₂: Objectively quantifies exercise tolerance, distinguishing dyspnea from cardiac/pulmonary/fitness; VO2peak and VE/VCO2 slope are key for heart-failure prognosis, transplant timing and pulmonary-hypertension risk, better than symptoms alone.
map.急性冠脉综合征未稳定、严重主动脉瓣狭窄、未控制心律失常、急性心衰等属禁忌；检查须: Unstable acute coronary syndrome, severe aortic stenosis, uncontrolled arrhythmia, acute heart failure are contraindications; test must be supervised in an exercise lab with resuscitation capability.
